searchText: I just completed the first prototype for this. It's my first smart contract too. A Goerli deposit for 0.0001 GoETH <https://goerli.etherscan.io/tx/0x9809fd6908945ee6529e0e894b4cef56203ab76f7dad5c970d3ed0051e9f7d73>. We should be able to create a custom launchpad to use this proxy deposit contract soon. There is another farming threat with any process to help stakers do their deposit on Goerli once withdrawal is added. Deposit for cheap > withdraw your deposit ASAP > farm GoETH > win. This would be a long con to start working on this today, but we've seen a lot of unexpected behaviors around Goerli. Modifying the withdrawal credentials along the way might help if possible. If someone needs GoETH to fund such a faucet at medium-scale, happy to provide it and see how long it lasts 😅 Our implementation is up! Try it and let us know. Cheap deposits can be whitelisted on your wallet address on https://discord.com/channels/694822223575384095/1026679645808119868/1026952485761454101 . Once you are whitelisted, you can do your deposits on this custom launchpad <https://goerli.launchpad.ethstaker.cc/>.
